questions.text: Which aspects are NOT regulated by Incoterms 2020?
options: Transfer of risk and transfer of costs between seller and buyer
Breaches of contract and consequences, payment modes, and applicable law
Procurement of means of transport and transport documents
Export, transit, and import customs formalities
questions.correctAnswer: Breaches of contract and consequences, payment modes, and applicable law

questions.text: Which four Incoterms 2020 rules are the blue rules that apply exclusively to sea and inland waterway transport?
options: EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP
DAP, DPU, DDP, EXW
FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF
FCA, CIP, DPU, FOB

questions.text: What characterizes Group C rules (CPT, CIP, CFR, CIF) as two-point rules?
options: Risk and costs transfer together only at the buyer's warehouse
Risk and costs transfer together right at the seller's premises
The buyer pays main carriage costs, while the seller bears transit risk
Risk transfers early at dispatch, while the seller pays costs to the destination
questions.correctAnswer: Risk transfers early at dispatch, while the seller pays costs to the destination

questions.text: Which Incoterms 2020 rule is the only one under which the seller is responsible for unloading the goods at the named destination?
options: DPU (Delivered at Place Unloaded)
DAP (Delivered at Place)
DDP (Delivered Duty Paid)
CIF (Cost Insurance Freight)

questions.text: BMW (Munich) ships cars by rail to Autohaus Robinson (Graz) under CPT Bahnhof Graz. Where does transport risk transfer to Autohaus Robinson?
options: Only after full unloading at Graz station
At the Austrian border near Kufstein
Already at Munich station upon handover to the first rail carrier
Inside Autohaus Robinson's showroom in Graz
questions.correctAnswer: Already at Munich station upon handover to the first rail carrier

questions.text: BWT ships water filters under CFR Port of Manila via Hamburg to Seda Hotels. Seawater damages the cargo during the ocean voyage. Who bears this risk?
options: BWT AG, because BWT paid the sea freight to Manila
Seda Hotels, because risk transferred on board the vessel in Hamburg
The freight forwarder in Hamburg for 100 percent of the loss
The Manila port authority as the destination port
questions.correctAnswer: Seda Hotels, because risk transferred on board the vessel in Hamburg

questions.text: Which rule represents the minimum obligation and which represents the maximum obligation for the seller?
options: Minimum obligation: EXW; maximum obligation: DDP
Minimum obligation: DDP; maximum obligation: EXW
Minimum obligation: FOB; maximum obligation: CIF
Minimum obligation: FCA; maximum obligation: CPT
questions.correctAnswer: Minimum obligation: EXW; maximum obligation: DDP

questions.text: Under CIP Bahnhof Wels from Milan, the Italian seller pays for transport insurance, yet the buyer in Wels must handle any transit damage claim with the insurer.
Incoterms 2020 apply automatically to every international sales contract even if they are not incorporated into the contract.
Explain the difference between one-point and two-point rules across the four Incoterms groups (E, F, C, D) and name the two rules that require the seller to arrange insurance.
questions.correctAnswer: In one-point rules (Groups E, F, and D), risk and costs transfer at the same place (e.g., EXW at seller's premises, FOB on board at shipment port, DAP at destination). In two-point rules (Group C: CPT, CIP, CFR, CIF), risk and costs transfer at two different places: risk passes early upon handover to the first carrier or on board, while the seller pays costs up to the named destination. The two rules requiring seller-arranged insurance are CIP and CIF.
